اقتصرتن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَصَرْتُنَّ (iqtaṣartunna) /iq.ta.sˤar.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# اُقْتُصِرْتُنَّ (uqtuṣirtunna) /uq.tu.sˤir.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
